facts.text: Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University is focused on aviation and aerospace education, teaching the science, practice, and business of aviation and aerospace for industry, government, and military leadership.

sources.title: About Embry-Riddle - Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
sources.quote: Our mission is to teach students the science, practice and business of aviation and aerospace, preparing them for leadership roles in industry, government agencies and the military.
